product.name: Gantry wheel plate
product.introText: The left-hand gantry wheel plate of the FarmBot Genesis v1.5: nine V-wheels on one plate, five with standard spacers and four with eccentric spacers. Steps, text and pictures are from the FarmBot Genesis v1.5 documentation, the parts are from its CAD model; both are published by FarmBot Inc. under the CC0 Public Domain Dedication. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by FarmBot Inc.
product.partsSummary: 1 gantry wheel plate, 9 V-wheels, 9 M5 x 30mm screws, 5 standard 6mm spacers, 4 eccentric spacers, 9 M5 flange locknuts, 2 60mm nut bars, 4 M5 x 10mm screws.  Tools (not shown): 3mm hex driver, 8mm box wrench, mallet.

steps.title: Attach the upper V-wheels
steps.text: Insert an M5 x 30mm screw through a V-wheel and a standard 6mm spacer. Then insert this into the gantry wheel plate as shown and add an M5 flange locknut on the other side of the plate. Tighten the wheel assembly using the 3mm hex driver and the 8mm box wrench. Repeat the above process for the remaining four V-wheels with standard spacers. All five of these wheels should be positioned on the plate in a straight line.

steps.title: Attach the lower V-wheels
steps.text: Insert an eccentric spacer into the gantry wheel plate. Snug fit: you may need to lightly tap the eccentric spacer into the hole using a mallet. Then insert an M5 x 30mm screw with a V-wheel through the spacer and secure the assembly with an M5 flange locknut on the other side of the plate. Repeat the above steps for the remaining V-wheels attached with the eccentric spacers.

steps.title: Attach the nut bars
steps.text: Loosely attach two 60mm nut bars to the plate using four M5 x 10mm screws. The nut bars should reside on the same side of the plate as the V-wheels.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Repeat the above steps for the second gantry wheel plate assembly. You should end up with two gantry wheel plate assemblies that are mirror images of each other. [Not shown here: this scenario builds the left-hand plate only.]

steps.title: Adjust the V-wheel spacing
steps.text: The eccentric spacers on the lower wheels of each gantry wheel plate assembly are used for making fine adjustments to the spacing between the lower wheels and the upper wheels. Adjusting this spacing is the key to having your gantry move smoothly and wobble-free across the tracks. If the spacing is too little, then the gantry will not fit onto the tracks at all or be tough to move. If the spacing is too great, then the gantry will be wobbly and loose. Adjust the eccentric spacers using the eccentric spacer adjustment reference guide. [Not shown here: nothing moves in this step.]
